title: The Real Reason Your Pain Feels Worse at Night
hook: Your pain actually feels worse at night because of brain chemistry.

narration.text: Your pain actually feels worse at night because of brain chemistry.
During the day, your brain produces more natural pain-relieving chemicals.
These endorphins and enkephalins help to suppress discomfort while you are active.
At night, production of these natural painkillers decreases.
This means your body has fewer resources to fight off painful sensations.
Also, with fewer distractions at night, your brain focuses more on the pain.
This can make even minor aches feel more intense and harder to ignore.
Have you noticed your pain changing at different times of day?

description: Ever wonder why a little ache feels like a big problem when you are trying to sleep? It is not just in your head, it is actually about your brain's natural pain management system.
topic: why pain feels worse at night
